description: Lists catalogue items by their store number (hero-12, app-crm-01, template-home), optionally filtered. access: open (free, no key) or pro (UI Pro). kind: ui (primitive), block (page section), app (app screen), template (whole page), skill (design rules for the agent: UI Pro, a website theme, the free library). category: e.g. "hero", "pricing", "footer", "app-crm", "templates", "skills".

access.description: Who may install: "open" for free items that need no key, "pro" for UI Pro items that need the user's API key. "account" is kept for older clients and matches nothing now. Leave out for both.

category.description: Store category slug, as in the item URLs: "hero", "pricing", "footer", "app-crm", "templates". Leave out for every category.

kind.description: What sort of item: "ui" a primitive (button, input), "block" a page section (hero, pricing), "app" an app screen, "template" a whole page, "skill" a design skill (SKILL.md that tells you how the blocks or a theme fit together). Leave out for all kinds.

limit.description: How many items to return, 1 to 200. Default 50.

offset.description: How many matching items to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

name: list_items
title: List themes.dev UI items
